$comment: Template for flags.secret.json (which is gitignored). Fill in a flag for every slug in src/lib/challenges.ts, then run `pnpm gen`. The generator hashes, encrypts and encodes everything into src/lib/generated/ -- the committed site never contains a plaintext flag, so this file is the only place the answers exist.

writeups.first-light: Markdown-ish explanation of the intended solve. Sealed with AES-GCM under a key derived from the flag, so it is unreadable until the challenge is solved.

honeypots.pctf{looks_real_isnt}: Message shown when someone submits this decoy. Decoys are planted in plain sight so that grepping the bundle is punished rather than rewarded.
